programmes.d: Martin & Lucy visit a cottage in Cornwall, a basement flat in London and a property in Sunderland.
Martin and Lucy visit properties in Devon, Liverpool and North London.
Martin and Lucy visit a house in Derby with lots of potential, a one bedroom flat in Oxford and a three bedroom semi in Manchester.
Martin and Lucy view properties in Derby, West London and Plymouth.
Martin & Lucy visit a derelict house in Darlington, a one bedroom flat in West Hampstead and a former social club with a first floor flat in Seaton.
Martin and Lucy visit a new build in Dawlish without a roof and floor; a perfect for rent property with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms in Sittingbourne and a 2 bedroom house in Derby.

Martin and Lucy visit a three bedroom house in Teignmouth, Devon that's worth a second look, take a gorgeous step back in time with a Dorchester, Grade 2 listed property, and visit a plot of land in Derby which could make someone a small fortune.
Martin and Lucy view a Warrington hardware shop, a flat in Redding and a maisonette in Devon.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Dorset that may not look too promising, a house in Hertfordshire and in Derbyshire all is not quiet as it seems.
Martin & Lucy visit a house in Cornwall, a large flat in Shepherds Bush and a terrace house in Gainsborough.

Martin and Lucy visit a flat in Yorkshire, a property in Kent set for retirement but perhaps it should have a new lease of life and we first saw this rectory farm house in 2005, its extensive renovation took 3 years to complete.
Martin and Lucy visit an old building in Wales needing some life restoring into it, a property in Margate, and a flat in Battersea with plenty of room for improvement.
Martin and Lucy visit a former army house in Wiltshire that may leave you shellshocked, a three-bed end of terrace lot with a garage and a Staffordshire property with enough bedrooms for a rock band!
Martin and Lucy visit a building plot in Sutton in Ashfield, a semi detached house in Southampton and a static mobile home in a retirement community in Lincolnshire.
Martin & Lucy visit a property in Stoke-on-Trent, a house with lots of room in Herne Bay, Kent and a two bedroom flat near Nottingham.

Martin and Lucy visit a property in rural Dorset with potential green credentials, a Victorian property – which should have high ceilings, character features and a sense of space, and a building in Staffordshire which seems to have a broad appeal.

Martin and Lucy visit a house in Cornwall that leaves a small but warm glow, a building in Faversham Kent could be a sound investment and in Yorkshire there's a property where small doesn't mean beautiful.
Martin & Lucy visit a house in Sunderland, a flat in London and a cottage in Somerset.
Martin and Lucy visit a ramshackle property in Lincolnshire, a Property in Epson Downs which has had is far share of downs and we go back to a bungalow in Devon first seen 4 years ago.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander visit a house in Derby, a pump house in Oxfordshire and a cottage in Plymouth.
Martin & Lucy visit a former school caretaker's house in Kent, an end of terraced house in London and a house in Cornwall.
